lead.text: Saturn is exactly square your Sun today, and the pressure is not asking for more effort — only for a promise small enough that you can actually keep it.

paragraphs.text: The square is exact at 2026-07-30T14:11:07Z; the wider cycle closes on 2027-01-26.
